ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized on the interior lobe surfaces versus 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle insertion, trailing edges, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions in the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and becomes mottled at the distal tips. Distinct black linear streaks intersect the white regions on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-8 pixel variance) creating a jagged profile along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch; convex curve along the visible portion of the leading edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the extreme distal tips, particularly on the left lobe, indicating focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). A prominent diagonal streak is visible on the left lobe, with multiple vertical and sub-vertical streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes and irregular nicks/indentations along the trailing edge perimeter.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-intensity white 'T' or cross-shaped mark is visible within the dark pigmentation zone immediately to the right of the median notch.
